description.value:
Whenever you deal Sneak Attack damage to a creature with anatomy you can exploit, you can give up two of those dice to inflict a debilitating strike instead. The save DC for these is 8 plus your proficiency bonus plus your Intelligence modifier.

Bleeding Wound. The target attempts a Constitution save. On a failure, for up to a minute it takes true damage equal to one Sneak Attack die at the start of each of its turns, repeating the save each time and ending the effect on a success.

Crippling Pain. The target attempts a Constitution save or has disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of your next turn.

Hampering Shot. The target attempts a Constitution save. On a failure, it gains one level of slowed and makes Dexterity saves with disadvantage until the end of its next turn.
